function.arguments: {"sections":[{"heading":"Executive Summary","paragraphs":["Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.","Willow Gardens is a 64-unit multifamily property in San Antonio, TX, analyzed as of August 31, 2026 from an original fictional evaluation packet. This document is an investment/sales offering memorandum and underwriting reconciliation; it is not a debt-request letter. No photographs, asking price, market rent or sale comparables, sponsor track record or street address are supplied in the packet, and none have been created here.","The certified rent roll dated 2026-08-31 governs physical occupancy: 48 of 64 units (75.00% by unit; 75.18% by area) are active and in possession, 5 units are leased but pending possession, and 11 units are vacant. The manager's cover note headlines 53 of 64 as leased by counting the 5 pending units; those occupants have not taken possession, so pending units are excluded from physical occupancy here and disclosed separately.","Underwriting per the acquisition analysis instructions produces stabilized EGI of $1,309,175, NOI before reserves of $890,640, and NCF after reserves of $871,440. Capitalized at 6.0000%, the indicated value is $14,843,996 ($231,937 per unit). Maximum loan proceeds are $8,821,131, constrained by the 1.25x DSCR test, implying 59.42% LTV and a 9.89% NCF debt yield. After the $7,200,000 existing payoff, a 1% origination fee and $45,000 of closing costs, net cash-out to the sponsor is $1,487,920.","Value shown is an income-capitalization indication derived from the prescribed 6.0000% rate in the instructions. It is not an asking price, an appraisal, or evidence of market pricing; no comparable sales are in the packet."],"table":{"headers":["Metric","Value","Basis"],"rows":[["Total units","64","rent-roll-certified.xlsx, Rent Roll A5:A68"],["Occupied (in possession)","48","Possession status = active"],["Pending (not in possession)","5","Possession status = pending"],["Vacant","11","Possession status = vacant"],["Unit occupancy","0.7500","48 / 64"],["Area occupancy","0.7518","46,560 / 61,930 SF"],["Gross potential rent (annual)","$1,354,500","All-unit scheduled rent $112,875 x 12"],["Underwritten EGI","$1,309,175","GPR less 5% loss plus $350/unit other income"],["Underwritten NOI (before reserves)","$890,640","EGI less $418,535 operating expenses"],["Underwritten NCF (after reserves)","$871,440","NOI less $300/unit reserves"],["Capitalization value at 6.0000%","$14,843,996","NOI before reserves / cap rate"],["Maximum loan","$8,821,131","DSCR-constrained"],["Net cash-out","$1,487,920","Proceeds less payoff, fee and costs"]]}},{"heading":"Property and Unit Mix","paragraphs":["The property comprises 64 residential units totaling 61,930 rentable square feet across three floor plans. The manager's group mapping (manager-cover.pdf p.1) assigns groups A, B and C in order to Studio, 1BR and 2BR. Scheduled rents on the certified roll are uniform within each plan: $1,575 for studios, $1,725 for one-bedrooms and $2,000 for two-bedrooms, equal to $1.92, $1.84 and $1.74 per SF per month respectively.","No amenity schedule, site plan, year built, parking count or photographs are provided in the packet; those items are unknown rather than zero."],"table":{"headers":["Group","Plan","Units","Occupied","Area SF","Monthly rent per unit"],"rows":[["A","Studio",22,16,"18,040","$1,575"],["B","1BR",21,16,"19,740","$1,725"],["C","2BR",21,16,"24,150","$2,000"],["Total","All plans",64,48,"61,930","$112,875 total"]]}},{"heading":"Lease and Occupancy Analysis","paragraphs":["Every lease on the certified roll expires 2029-08-31, roughly three years beyond the evaluation date. Under the instructions, near-term rollover means an active unit expiry within the next 12 months; there is none, so near-term rollover exposure is absent as of 2026-08-31. The uniform expiry does, however, concentrate the entire rent roll into a single 2029 rollover window, which a buyer should plan for even though it falls outside the 12-month test.","Annualized in-place rent from the 48 occupied units is $1,017,600, versus $1,354,500 of gross potential rent for all 64 units. The $336,900 gap is vacancy and pending-possession loss, of which the 5 pending units represent $103,500 of annual scheduled rent that is contracted but not yet in possession.","Suite 001 is supported by an executed lease at $1,575 per month for 820 SF expiring 2029-08-31, with a $3,150 security deposit and no free-rent concession as of the evaluation date. Manager correspondence dated August 31, 2026 confirms that no amendment or new concession affects Suite 001. The stale archive roll dated 2026-06-30 shows lower rents ($1,500 / $1,650 / $1,925); that roll is superseded by the 2026-08-31 certified roll and is not used for underwriting. This is a resolvable dated-document conflict, not an open issue.","No unsigned rent proposal or unexecuted amendment appears anywhere in the packet, and no temporary free-rent period is documented."],"table":{"headers":["Status","Units","Area SF","Monthly scheduled rent","Annual scheduled rent"],"rows":[["Active (in possession)",48,"46,560","$84,800","$1,017,600"],["Pending (not in possession)",5,"4,780","$8,625","$103,500"],["Vacant",11,"10,590","$19,450","$233,400"],["Total",64,"61,930","$112,875","$1,354,500"]]}},{"heading":"Historical versus Underwritten Financials","paragraphs":["The trailing twelve months ended 2026-08-31 reflect cash collections of $1,219,050 against real estate taxes of $142,222, insurance of $47,408 and other recurring operating expenses of $189,630, producing the reported T-12 NOI of $839,790. The statement discloses that the roof replacement is a capital improvement booked at $0 in repairs with no recurring repair component, so the historical ledger does not embed capital spending in operating expenses. No management fee is separately reported in the T-12 ledger, and historical collections are cash receipts rather than an annualized rent-roll total.","Underwriting follows the prescribed instructions rather than the historical statement for revenue: all-unit scheduled monthly rent on the certified roll (before any Suite 001 amendment) times twelve, a 5% economic loss, and $350 per unit of annual other income. Reimbursement income is already inside that figure and is not added twice. Expenses use the prescribed tax, insurance and other recurring amounts, a 3% management fee on underwritten EGI, and a $300 per unit replacement reserve. NOI before reserves is capitalized; DSCR and debt yield are sized on NCF after reserves.","Underwritten NOI before reserves of $890,640 exceeds reported T-12 NOI of $839,790 by $50,850. The difference is definitional: underwriting applies a stabilized 95%-of-potential revenue assumption plus other income and adds a management fee the historical ledger does not carry, while the historical figure reflects actual collections during a partially vacant period."],"table":{"headers":["Line","T-12 actual","Underwritten (stabilized)"],"rows":[["Gross potential rent","not reported separately","$1,354,500"],["Economic loss at 5%","-","($67,725)"],["Other income at $350/unit","included in collections","$22,400"],["Revenue / EGI","$1,219,050","$1,309,175"],["Real estate taxes","($142,222)","($142,222)"],["Insurance","($47,408)","($47,408)"],["Other recurring operating expenses","($189,630)","($189,630)"],["Management fee (3% of EGI)","$0 reported","($39,275)"],["Roof replacement in repairs (capital)","$0","not underwritten as opex"],["Total operating expenses","($379,260)","($418,535)"],["NOI before reserves","$839,790","$890,640"],["Replacement reserves ($300/unit)","not reported","($19,200)"],["NCF after reserves","not reported","$871,440"]]}},{"heading":"Debt Sizing and Sources / Uses","paragraphs":["Sizing uses the greater of the 6.9000% note rate and the 6.00% underwriting floor, i.e. 6.9000%, applied to a 30-year monthly amortizing constant even though the first 24 months are interest-only. Because the note rate exceeds the floor, the floor is not binding.","The three constraints produce $8,906,398 on LTV, $8,821,131 on DSCR and $9,682,664 on debt yield. DSCR binds, so maximum proceeds are $8,821,131: a 59.42% implied LTV, 9.89% NCF debt yield and 1.25x amortizing DSCR (4.20x during the interest-only period at $608,658 of annual interest).","Proceeds exceed the $7,200,000 payoff plus $88,211 origination fee and $45,000 closing costs by $1,487,920, so there is no refinance shortfall on these assumptions and no additional equity is required. The cushion is sensitive to the prescribed cap rate through the currently non-binding LTV test; a materially higher cap rate would make LTV binding and compress cash-out (see the workbook sensitivity grid)."],"table":{"headers":["Item","Amount"],"rows":[["Underwritten NCF (sizing basis)","$871,440"],["Sizing rate / amortization","6.9000% / 360 months"],["LTV limit (60.00% of $14,843,996)","$8,906,398"],["DSCR limit (1.25x)","$8,821,131"],["Debt yield limit (9.00%)","$9,682,664"],["Maximum loan (binding: DSCR)","$8,821,131"],["Use - existing loan payoff","$7,200,000"],["Use - origination fee (1.00%)","$88,211"],["Use - closing costs","$45,000"],["Total uses","$7,333,211"],["Source - new loan proceeds","$8,821,131"],["Net cash-out to sponsor","$1,487,920"]]}},{"heading":"Risks and Missing Diligence","paragraphs":["Risk assessments below use present, absent or unresolved and are made independently of one another.","Missing diligence: legal, environmental, property condition and title reviews are not complete per diligence-status.pdf. These are routine outstanding items; the packet supplies no evidence of contamination, litigation, fraud or structural failure, and none is asserted here. Also unknown rather than zero: asking price, photographs, market rent and sale comparables, sponsor history, property address, lender term sheet, tenant credit detail, and any capital expenditure plan beyond the completed roof replacement."],"table":{"headers":["Risk","Assessment","Basis"],"rows":[["Pending units counted in occupancy","present","manager-cover.pdf p.1 headlines 53/64 leased including 5 unpossessed pending units; certified roll shows 48 active"],["Near-term rollover (next 12 months)","absent","All expirations 2029-08-31; none within 12 months of 2026-08-31"],["Missing insurance evidence","absent","insurance.pdf p.1 policy in force 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30, $2,000,000 GL aggregate"],["Capital item classified in operating expenses","absent","operating-statement.pdf p.1: roof replacement $0 in repairs, identified as capital"],["Unsigned rent change relied upon","absent","No unsigned proposal in packet; lease-correspondence.pdf p.1 confirms no Suite 001 amendment"],["Temporary free rent","absent","lease-001.pdf p.1: no free-rent concession as of evaluation date"],["Sizing rate floor binding","absent","Note 6.9000% exceeds 6.00% floor; sizing uses note rate"],["Refinance shortfall","absent","$8,821,131 proceeds cover $7,333,211 of uses; $1,487,920 surplus"],["2029 single-date rollover concentration","present (outside 12-month test)","All 64 leases expire 2029-08-31"],["Stale archive roll conflict","resolved","rent-roll-archive.xlsx (2026-06-30) superseded by certified roll (2026-08-31)"]]}},{"heading":"Source Notes","paragraphs":["All figures trace to the nine files in the supplied packet; no external data, market research or outreach was used. The accompanying workbook exposes gross_potential_rent (Inputs!B4), cap_rate (Inputs!B13) and sizing_rate (Inputs!B16) as live inputs, and computes uw_egi (UW!B6), uw_noi (UW!B13), uw_ncf (UW!B15), capitalization_value (UW!B18), maximum_loan (Debt!B8) and net_cash_out (Debt!B23) with Excel formulas, plus a cap-rate/sizing-rate sensitivity grid and a source register.","This is original fictional evaluation material; no real transaction, address, sponsor or price is represented."],"table":{"headers":["File","Date / as-of","Location","Use"],"rows":[["rent-roll-certified.xlsx","2026-08-31","Rent Roll B2, A5:G68","Controlling unit count, area, possession status, scheduled rents, expirations"],["rent-roll-archive.xlsx","2026-06-30","Rent Roll E5:E68","Stale prior rents; superseded, not underwritten"],["lease-001.pdf","n/a","p.1","Suite 001 executed rent $1,575, 820 SF, expiry 2029-08-31, no free rent"],["lease-correspondence.pdf","2026-08-31","p.1","No amendments or new concessions on Suite 001"],["operating-statement.pdf","2025-09-01 to 2026-08-31","p.1","T-12 collections, tax, insurance, other opex, reported NOI $839,790, roof capital $0"],["insurance.pdf","2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30","p.1","GL aggregate limit $2,000,000 (coverage limit, not expense)"],["underwriting-instructions.pdf","n/a","p.1","All underwriting assumptions and loan constraints"],["manager-cover.pdf","n/a","p.1","53/64 leased headline; A/B/C = Studio/1BR/2BR mapping"],["diligence-status.pdf","n/a","p.1","Outstanding legal, environmental, PCA and title reviews"]]}}],"subtitle":"Investment / Sales Offering Memorandum and Underwriting Reconciliation - as of August 31, 2026 - 64-unit multifamily, San Antonio, TX (original fictional evaluation material)","title":"Willow Gardens"}
